title: plaid.com/docs/account/billing
snippet:
Plaid offers four pricing plans:
*   **Trial** – Best for exploring Plaid or building a hobby project. Free access, with a limit of 10 Production Items. To learn more, see [Trial plans](https://plaid.com/docs/account/billing/index.html.md#trial-plans) .
*   **Pay-as-you-go** – Best for individuals and solo developers. No minimum spend, commitment, or usage cap. You pay each month for what you use. Includes Plaid's [core products](https://plaid.com/docs/account/billing/index.html.md#core-products-available-on-all-paid-plans) and self-service support via docs, help center, and community resources.
*   **Growth** – Best for startups and new businesses. Annual plan with a minimum spend commitment and discounted rates. Includes business-focused features such as support with response-time SLAs (service-level agreements), single sign-on (SSO), and a dedicated account manager for qualifying contracts.
*   **Custom** (also called Scale) – Best for businesses that need flexible billing or support for regulated industries. Offers the lowest rates, with custom commitments and billing terms. Includes every Plaid product and access to beta products. Integration assistance and premium support are available as add-ons.

Plaid has multiple different pricing models, depending on the product. These models only apply to Production traffic; usage of Sandbox is always free.
Note that the details outlined below are general information and guidance about typical pricing structures and policies for new customers. Your specific pricing and billing structure is governed by your agreement with Plaid. If you have questions about your bill, [contact support](https://dashboard.plaid.com/support/new/admin/account-administration/pricing) .
Endpoints that are not associated with any particular product are typically available to Plaid customers free of charge. Examples of these free-to-use endpoints include [Institutions endpoints](https://plaid.com/docs/api/institutions/index.html.md) , [Item endpoints](https://plaid.com/docs/api/items/index.html.md) , [/accounts/get](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts/index.html.md#accountsget) (not to be confused with [/accounts/balance/get](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/signal/index.html.md#accountsbalanceget) , which is associated with the Balance product), and [user management endpoints](https://plaid.com/docs/api/users/index.html.md) .

title: How are Sandbox, Production, Trial plan, and Limited Production different?
snippet:
Trial plan and Limited Production are two ways to access Production for free, on a limited basis, before applying for full paid access.

| | Sandbox | Production (full) | Trial plan | Limited Production |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Cost** | Free | Paid | Free | Free |
| **Data** | Mock | Real | Real | Real, with usage caps |
| **Item limit** | Unlimited | Unlimited | 10 Production Items | Capped |
| **Approval** | None | Required (a few business days; company + use-case info) | Auto-approved for most developers | Required |
| **Availability** | All developers | All developers | US/CA developers, signups on or after April 15, 2026 | Existing Limited Production customers only (no new US/CA signups after April 15, 2026) |
| **Best for** | Building and testing without touching live data | Deploying your application | Trying Plaid with real data before committing to a paid plan | Legacy free-tier access for existing customers |

For developers in the US and Canada who sign up on or after April 15, 2026, Plaid offers a [Trial plan](https://plaid.com/docs/account/billing/#trial-plans) — a free way to use Plaid with real production data before applying for full Production access. Trial plans are auto-approved for most developers and support up to 10 Production Items. Eight core products are included: [Auth](https://plaid.com/docs/auth/), [Transactions](https://plaid.com/docs/transactions/) (including Transactions Refresh), [Balance](https://plaid.com/docs/balance/), [Identity](https://plaid.com/docs/identity/), [Assets](https://plaid.com/docs/assets/), [Liabilities](https://plaid.com/docs/liabilities/), [Investments](https://plaid.com/docs/investments/) (including Investments Refresh), and [Statements](https://plaid.com/docs/statements/).

Absolutely. Our Limited Production service allows you to make up to 200 API calls with each available product using live data. This is the best way to start learning about and testing Plaid’s APIs.
We offer three basic pricing models based on the product(s) you’re using and how it’s designed: one-time, subscription, and per-request.
- **One-time fee products**: You’ll incur a charge only once per connected account, regardless of the number of API calls made.
- **Subscription products**: These incur a monthly fee for each connected account.
- **Per-request products**: These have a flat fee for every successful API call.

title: plaid.com/docs/sandbox
snippet:
Most products can be immediately tested in Sandbox with no extra configuration. Some products, such as Payment Initiation (UK and Europe), may require your account be specially enabled. If the product you want to test against is not available in Sandbox, file a request for access ticket via the [Dashboard](https://dashboard.plaid.com/support/new/admin/account-administration/request-product-access) .

Free Trial plans (US and Canada only) are available to new Plaid teams created on or after April 15, 2026.

Limited Production has been replaced with [Trial plans](https://plaid.com/docs/account/billing/index.html.md#trial-plans) for all Plaid teams created on or after April 15, 2026. Trial plans offer free access to the Plaid API and, unlike Limited Production, provide access to almost all institutions prior to full Production approval.

If you have any free API calls remaining, as long as you are a direct customer of Plaid, you can continue to use them after receiving Production access; once those credits have been used up, your usage will be billed as normal Production traffic. If you are _not_ a direct customer of Plaid and instead are accessing Plaid via a reseller partner, your free API credits will expire once you receive full Production access.

title: What is the Plaid Trial plan?
snippet:
The Plaid Trial plan provides free access to Plaid's production APIs. You can connect real financial accounts, call production endpoints, and build projects — no business registration, security questionnaire, or sales process required.
## Who can sign up
The Trial plan is available to developers who:
- Are located in the United States or Canada
- Do not already have an existing Plaid Production or Limited Production account
US and Canadian institutions are available on Trial plans, all other institutions are not currently available on this plan type. To get started, go to [dashboard.plaid.com/signup](https://dashboard.plaid.com/signup).

title: What are Plaid's prices and pricing plans, and how do they differ?
snippet:
Plaid offers a variety of pricing plans to cater to different needs and usage levels. These plans are designed to provide flexibility and scalability, whether you're a small startup or a large enterprise. There are four main pricing plans offered by Plaid: Trial (free), Pay-as-you-go, Growth, and Custom (also known as Scale).
For customers based in the EU or UK, or who serve end users in the EU or UK, we only offer Custom plans at this time. Additionally, the following products are only offered via Custom plans:
- Signal Transaction Scores
- Transfer
- Document Income with bank statements support
- Consumer Report (by Plaid Check) products other than Base Report and Income Insights. No Plaid Check products are available on Pay-as-you-go; Base Report and Income Insights are available on Growth or Custom.
- Payment Initiation (including Variable Recurring Payments) and Virtual Accounts
- Layer
- Protect

For developers in the US and Canada creating a new Plaid team on or after April 15, 2026, Plaid offers a free [Trial plan](https://plaid.com/docs/account/billing/#trial-plans). The Trial plan lets you use Plaid with real production data at no cost, with a cap of 10 Production Items. It includes eight bundled products: [Auth](https://plaid.com/docs/auth/), [Transactions](https://plaid.com/docs/transactions/) (including Transactions Refresh), [Balance](https://plaid.com/docs/balance/), [Identity](https://plaid.com/docs/identity/), [Assets](https://plaid.com/docs/assets/), [Liabilities](https://plaid.com/docs/liabilities/), [Investments](https://plaid.com/docs/investments/) (including Investments Refresh), and [Statements](https://plaid.com/docs/statements/). Almost all [OAuth institutions](https://plaid.com/docs/link/oauth/) are accessible immediately, without completing the full Production registration process. To sign up, visit [dashboard.plaid.com/signup](https://dashboard.plaid.com/signup).
The Trial plan is available to new Plaid accounts that have not yet applied for or been granted any form of Production access. If your team has a pending or approved Production application, or existing [Limited Production](https://plaid.com/docs/quickstart/glossary/#limited-production) access, the Trial plan is not available — there is currently no self-service way to switch.
